papers.title: Patchwork Kriging for Large-scale Gaussian Process Regression
papers.abstract: This paper presents a new approach for Gaussian process (GP) regression for large datasets. The approach involves partitioning the regression input domain into multiple local regions with a different local GP model fitted in each region. Unlike existing local partitioned GP approaches, we introduce a technique for patching together the local GP models nearly seamlessly to ensure that the local GP models for two neighboring regions produce nearly the same response prediction and prediction error variance on the boundary between the two regions. This largely mitigates the well-known discontinuity problem that degrades the boundary accuracy of existing local partitioned GP methods. Our main innovation is to represent the continuity conditions as additional pseudo-observations that the differences between neighboring GP responses are identically zero at an appropriately chosen set of boundary input locations. To predict the response at any input location, we simply augment the actual response observations with the pseudo-observations and apply standard GP prediction methods to the augmented data. In contrast to heuristic continuity adjustments, this has an advantage of working within a formal GP framework, so that the GP-based predictive uncertainty quantification remains valid. Our approach also inherits a sparse block-like structure for the sample covariance matrix, which results in computationally efficient closed-form expressions for the predictive mean and variance. In addition, we provide a new spatial partitioning scheme based on a recursive space partitioning along local principal component directions, which makes the proposed approach applicable for regression domains having more than two dimensions. Using three spatial datasets and three higher dimensional datasets, we investigate the numerical performance of the approach and compare it to several state-of-the-art approaches.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种适用于大规模高斯过程回归的补丁克里金方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中，提高计算效率并提供不确定性量化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模高斯过程回归计算成本高，局部分区方法存在边界不连续问题。
summary_zh.method: 通过引入伪观测强制相邻局部GP模型边界连续，实现无缝拼接。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据上比现有方法更准确，且保持有效的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 在3个空间数据集和3个高维数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Large-scale Gaussian process regression suffers from high computational costs and local partitioning methods often produce boundary discontinuities.
summary_en.method: A patchwork approach enforces continuity between adjacent local GP models by adding pseudo-observations that force zero difference at boundary points.
summary_en.result: The method achieves higher accuracy than existing local GP approaches on several datasets while maintaining valid uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three spatial and three higher-dimensional datasets.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of TiB 2 /H13 steel nanocomposites: Influence of hot isostatic pressing post-treatment

corresponding_authors.name: Bandar AlMangour
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, University of California, Los Angeles, CA 90095, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究H13工具钢的SLM与HIP后处理，完全不含生物医学植入物或骨整合内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses H13 tool steel (not a biomedical alloy), lacks any implant-related mechanical testing (stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness for osseointegration), and provides no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善SLM成型TiB2/H13钢复合材料的致密度与力学性能
summary_zh.method: 对SLM试样进行热等静压后处理并表征微观组织与硬度
summary_zh.result: HIP后处理显著消除孔隙，提升硬度与断裂韧性
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、硬度测试和压缩测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the densification and mechanical performance of selective laser melted TiB2/H13 steel nanocomposites through hot isostatic pressing post-treatment.
summary_en.method: The study applied hot isostatic pressing to as-built SLM samples and characterized the resulting microstructural evolution and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The HIP treatment effectively eliminated internal pores, leading to substantial improvements in hardness and fracture toughness.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using scanning electron microscopy, hardness testing, and compression tests.

papers.title: Surface Modification of Titanium with BMP-2/GDF-5 by a Heparin Linker and Its Efficacy as a Dental Implant.
papers.abstract: In this study, we prepared human bone morphogenetic protein-2 (hBMP-2)/human growth and differentiation factor-5 (hGDF-5)-coated titanium (Ti) disc and screw types for controlled release of the growth factors (GFs). The two growth factors were coated onto Ti with a smooth surface using their specific interaction with heparin, because they have heparin binding sites in their molecular structures. Efficacy of the two growth factor-coated Ti for enhancement of bone formation and osseointegration was compared to pristine Ti, and hBMP-2- and hGDF-5-coated Ti in vivo. The surface chemical composition, surface morphology, and wettability characteristics of the metal samples were determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and contact angle measurement, respectively. The initial burst of hBMP-2, hGDF-5, and their combination, occurred within one day of the release study, resulting in 12.5%, 4.5%, and 13.5%/3.2%, and then there was a sustained, even release of these two growth factors from the coated metal for 30 days. In vitro tests revealed that MC3T3-E1 cells cultured on the two growth factor-coated Ti had a higher proliferation rate and a higher activity for alkaline phosphatase (ALP), which led to a larger amount of calcium deposition and larger expressions of type I collagen (COL 1), ALP, and osteocalcin (OCN) mRNAs. In vivo animal tests using ten white New Zealand rabbits showed that the two growth factor-coated Ti enhanced bone formation and osseointegration at the interface between the implants and host bone. In addition, histological evaluation showed that bone remodeling, including bone formation by osteoblasts and bone resorption by osteoclasts, actively occurred between the two growth factor-coated Ti and host bone. Consequently, it is suggested that Ti surface modification with the combination of hBMP-2 and hGDF-5 for the two growth factor-coated Ti implants can improve the clinical properties of implants for orthopedic and dental applications.

llm.why_not_core: Does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structure, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or stress shielding analysis; focuses solely on growth factor coating on smooth Ti surfaces.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过肝素链接子在钛表面加载BMP-2/GDF-5以促进骨整合
summary_zh.method: 制备hBMP-2/hGDF-5涂层钛片与螺钉，表征表面性质并释放动力学
summary_zh.result: 涂层钛促进细胞增殖、ALP活性和体内骨整合

summary_en.motivation: To enhance osseointegration of dental implants by coating titanium surfaces with growth factors BMP-2 and GDF-5 via a heparin linker.
summary_en.method: Titanium discs and screws were coated with hBMP-2 and hGDF-5 using heparin binding, and surface properties and release kinetics were characterized.
summary_en.result: Coated titanium promoted MC3T3-E1 cell proliferation, ALP activity, and in vivo bone formation and osseointegration in rabbit models.
summary_en.validation: Validation through in vitro cell assays and in vivo rabbit implantation with histological evaluation.
